{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation updates (doc/REST-interface.md and release notes) follow directly from the index and RPC changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation changes in this PR are purely accompanying docs for the txindex and RPC features."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/txindex.h, and associated index tests are modified to allow txindex to operate on pruned nodes.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Resolves four long-standing issues dating back to 2017 requesting txindex support on pruned nodes (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240). By removing the requirement to store the full raw block history on disk, it provides a major user-facing enhancement for resource-constrained node operators."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp, src/rpc/txoutproof.cpp, src/rpc/util.cpp, and src/rest.cpp are modified to return structured error information for pruned transactions.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "RPC methods getrawtransaction and gettxoutproof, along with the REST /tx endpoint, gain structured error reporting containing pruned block hashes. This fills an interface gap, allowing client applications to fetch missing blocks on demand via getblockfrompeer."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "test/functional/test_runner.py is only touched to register the new functional test feature_txindex_prune.py.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The PR adds tests specifically to exercise the new txindex prune functionality rather than modifying shared test runner machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "src/init.cpp changes merely relax the startup argument validation preventing -txindex with -prune.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change shared utility libraries, logging, or core configuration primitives."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 3,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
